header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: and hidayah; may this be a crescent of good and hidayah; may this be a crescent of good and hidayah', he would say three times. Then he would say (آمَنْتُ بِالَّذِي خَلَقَكَ) I believe in Allah Ta'ala who created you. Then he would say (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي ذَهَبَ بِشَهْرِ كَذَا وَجَاءَ بِشَهْرِ كَذَا) “All praise is for Allah Ta'ala alone, who brought such-and-such month to an end and began such-and-such month!' — Hazrat Qatadah (RH) has said that this hadith reached him.

blocks.text: Explanation:- In the above Du'a, in place of كَذَا mention the name of the month that has passed, and in place of the next one the name of the month that has begun.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُمَرَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ رَأَي صَاحِبَ بَلَاءٍ فَقَالَ: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلي كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً إِلَّا عُوفِيَ مِنْ ذلِكَ الَْبَلَاءِ كَائِناً مَاكَانَ مَا عَاشَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث غريب باب مَاجاء مَايَقُولُ اذا راي مبتلي رقم:٣٤٣١
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever sees someone afflicted by hardship and recites (اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلي كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلا) All praise is for Allah Ta'ala alone, who saved me from the trial in which you have been put, and made me better than many of His creation! — he will be protected from that affliction for his whole life, whatever kind of hardship it may be!” — Hazrat Umar (RA) says that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Hazrat Ja'far (RH) says that these words should be said silently within oneself, so that the afflicted person does not hear them.
(Tirmidhi)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ
